_comment: Serial-number -> English district name mapping for mpkrishi.mp.gov.in's compendium PDFs (verified against this PDF's own row order, 2026-08-07). Built because the PDF's Devanagari district-name text extracts with a systematic character-drop artifact for स in some name/vowel-sign combinations (e.g. 'सागर' extracts as 'िागर'), and because MP districts are listed by administrative division (Jabalpur, Sagar, Rewa, Bhopal, Indore, Ujjain, Gwalior-Chambal, Narmadapuram divisions in that order), not alphabetically -- so position alone isn't safe without this explicit mapping. Covers the 52-district structure current as of the 2019-20 report (before the later Maihar/Pandhurna/Mauganj/Nagda splits).
